title: Small steps: Read the body before the story
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: The adult can keep everyone safe.
practice: check what the child's body may be communicating
principle: Use observable cues without diagnosing or mind-reading.
nextSentence: The adult can keep everyone safe. First, check what the child's body may be communicating.
keyLearning: Use observable cues without diagnosing or mind-reading.
